column8: ∀ (table : Minidregg.Kernel.CellTable), List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) (List.map (fun entry => entry.1.value) table.entries)

∀ (table : Minidregg.Kernel.CellTable) (cellId other : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (bytes : List UInt8), (table.insert cellId bytes).get other = if cellId = other then Option.some bytes else table.get other

∀ (cells : List (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × List UInt8)) (cellId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), (Minidregg.Kernel.CellTable.ofList cells).get cellId = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Seed.lookup cells cellId

∀ (cells : List (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId × List UInt8)) (table : Minidregg.Kernel.CellTable) (key : ℕ), (List.foldl (fun table cell => Std.ExtTreeMap.insertIfNew table cell.1.value cell.2) table cells)[key]? = table[key]?.or (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Seed.lookup cells { value := key })

∀ (list : List (ℕ × List UInt8)), List.Pairwise (fun a b => ¬Ord.compare a.1 b.1 = Ordering.eq) list → ∀ (key : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Seed.lookup (List.map (fun entry => ({ value := entry.1 }, entry.2)) list) { value := key } = Option.map Prod.snd (List.find? (fun entry => Ord.compare entry.1 key == Ordering.eq) list)
